Definition
[Geometric convergence of groups] \group thurston.ch09.convergenceSource: thurston:page-0241 A sequence of closed subgroups $\Gamma _i$ of a Lie group $G$ converges geometrically to $\Gamma $ if every $\gamma \in \Gamma $ is the limit of elements $\gamma _i\in \Gamma _i$, and every limit of a convergent sequence $\gamma _{i_j}\in \Gamma _{i_j}$ belongs to $\Gamma $. The resulting topology on closed subgroups is the geometric topology.
